editorial:
Imagine a world where the strongest fighters are hunted down by a crazy dictator named Bison. You get to follow Ryu, a wanderer who just wants to get stronger, and his best friend Ken, who is a bit more flashy and famous. The movie feels like a high-energy comic book brought to life, blending martial arts with a bit of a spy movie vibe. You will see Guile and Chun Li teaming up to take down Bison's evil organization, and the chemistry between all these legendary characters makes the whole experience feel like a huge party for fight fans.

The animation is the real star here because the fights look smooth and powerful even by today's standards. While the plot is a bit simple and some characters don't get much screen time, the action more than makes up for it. You should definitely check this out if you love old-school anime or just want something exciting to watch on a Friday night.
endingExplained: In the big finale, Ryu and Ken team up to fight Bison in a massive battle. Ryu manages to overcome his inner darkness and hits Bison with a powerful attack that finally destroys the villain for good. With Bison gone, his evil empire falls apart. The movie ends with Ryu and Ken shaking hands and heading off to find more strong opponents, proving that their friendship is just as strong as their fighting skills.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves retro gaming and martial arts action.
